_about: Plays-right tolerances for Leon (player and camera), agreed in the brief (lane eng-host, 2026-11-19). Why each value: docs/engine/PLAYS_RIGHT.md section 5.
_ang_deg: degrees, wrapped; yaw, pitch and roll
_frame: motion frame: exact (frames advance by whole steps; a frame off is a tick off)
_cam: units; camera eye and target, per axis
_event_ticks: outcome.py (lane eng-svc5): a kill, a hit, a spawn or removal, an event-word change and the room clear may come this many ticks apart (0.1 s at 30 ticks a second); amounts and order are exact. A proposal for the integrator: on the PC every native pair is 0 apart
_exact: motion id, motion state, routine (r_no_0..3), discrete hash and generator state are compared exactly
